Dinner at Beirut
May 2026 • Family
Beirut Restaurant is a fun Lebanese restaurant with a lively atmosphere, great for dinner with friends or family in Thảo Điền. The food is flavorful and authentic, especially the hummus, grilled meats, kebabs, and fresh pita bread. Portions are generous and the mixed grill is a standout.

The belly dancers performance is one of the main attractions. The show adds a vibrant Middle Eastern vibe to the evening, with energetic music and interactive dancing that keeps the crowd entertained. It turns dinner into more of a full nightlife experience rather than just a meal.

Overall, it’s a great spot if you want good Lebanese food, music, and entertainment in a lively setting.
